answer_1.quote: For toxic response generation, we use Advbench. For error code generation, we focus on Code_Injection. Knowledge reasoning task datasets consist of GSM8K, MATH, CSQA, and StrategyQA. For specific question-answering tasks, we cover NQ, HotpotQA, and MS-MARCO.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses for toxic instructions, code snippets for code injection, answers for question-answering tasks, and reasoning outputs for knowledge tasks.

answer_2.quote: We provide five main evaluation metrics, including clean accuracy (CACC) (i.e., the prediction accuracy of clean samples), attack success rate (ASR) (i.e., the prediction accuracy of poisoned samples to the target class), false trigger rate (FTR) (i.e., the activation rate of false trigger samples to the target class), Refusal Rate (RR) (i.e.,the refuse rate of poisoned samples), Pass Rate (PassR) (i.e., the pass rate of clean code-request samples). For stealthiness analysis, we provide semantic similarity change (∆e) and perplexity change (∆p).
